enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Poison Burst: This weapon is dripping with poison, and deals 1 to 6 poison damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 poison damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.

children.tooltip: Constitution Poison, Virulent: The deadly poison coating this weapon deals one point of constitution damage every time it strikes an enemy, and an additional 1 to 6 points of constitution damage when it scores a critical hit. Some creatures may be immune or resistant to ability damage.

Dexterity Poison, Virulent: The deadly poison coating this weapon deals one point of dexterity damage every time it strikes an enemy, and an additional 1 to 6 points of dexterity damage when it scores a critical hit. Some creatures may be immune or resistant to ability damage.

Strength Poison, Virulent: The deadly poison coating this weapon deals one point of strength damage every time it strikes an enemy, and an additional 1 to 6 points of strength damage when it scores a critical hit. Some creatures may be immune or resistant to ability damage.

enchantments.tooltip: Negative Energy Spike: This weapon is pulsating with negative energy. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of negative energy damage on a successful hit.
Life Stealing: This weapon has a chance to drain 1 to 3 levels from its target on a critical hit.
Lesser Vampirism: This weapon drains a tiny portion of the target's life force whenever it does damage.Note: provides 1 hp of healing per hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
